modules.title: Captive Portal: Overview
objectives: Explain in one sentence what the Captive Portal does for a customer
modules.content_markdown:
## What is it?

The Captive Portal is the branded sign-in page guests see when they join the network. It gets guests online fast while giving the operator branding, terms acceptance, and usage analytics.

quiz.question: What does the operator gain from a Captive Portal?
quiz.explanation: The portal adds branding, terms acceptance and analytics on top of connectivity.

modules.title: Value & Objection Handling
objectives: Handle the two most common objections
modules.content_markdown:
## Why the customer buys

- A polished, branded guest experience
- Compliance (terms acceptance) handled automatically
- Insight into who is connecting and when

### Objections
1. "It's too expensive" -> frame against the value of guest data and brand experience.
2. "We already have wifi" -> this is the experience and control layer on top of wifi.
